How long does a project take?
Most projects take 12 to 20 weeks from signed proposal to handover. Made-to-order lead times set most of that time. Installation usually takes about one week on site.

Can you renovate or build cabinets?
No. We do not build, renovate, or install cabinetry, plumbing, or wiring. The space should be finished before we start.
How many changes can I ask for?
The design stage includes two revision rounds. We settle the layout, materials, and furnishing plan with you before we order anything.

Living, dining, four bedrooms, covered terrace
A family of five moved into a newly built hillside house with deep eaves and large openings. They wanted rooms that stay cool and calm and that hold up to children.

The house faces the valley and has deep eaves, so the rooms stay shaded and cool. We kept furniture low and left clear sightlines to the garden from the living room, the dining room, and the terrace. Cane panels and open weaves let air move through the house without fans running all day.

Kanlungan means shelter. It is the feeling we design for.

We started in 2019 with one idea: a home should be the easiest place to be. We work from Makati with a team of twelve, and with workshops from Pampanga to Samar. We furnish homes and small hotels, and we keep a small shop of the pieces we trust.

We keep the studio small on purpose. Every project has one designer who stays with it from the first call to the last cushion. You always know who to ask.
